booking-1.title: Wonderful
booking-1.text: Lovely host. Thoughtful touches on our arrival. Wonderful location, a stone’s throw from the island’s most beautiful beaches

booking-2.title: Exceptional
booking-2.text: The location close to the beach, the well-equipped and clean accommodation, the quality of the kitchen utensils, the effectiveness of the air conditioning
booking-2.negative: A little more space in the kitchen to put the appliances would be welcome, but you can’t move the walls

booking-3.title: A gem a 5-minute walk from the magnificent Santa Giulia beach
booking-3.text: The welcome, the location and the comfort

booking-4.title: Great location, nice host and good amenities.
booking-4.text: Very friendly host who was always helpful. An incredible amount of kitchen equipment for the size of the apartment. There was even a tabletop grill and a juicer.

booking-5.title: A wonderful week in a strategic location for visiting beautiful beaches and Bonifacio, all just a few kilometres away
booking-5.text: The location near the beach, easy parking, coffee machine, and the terrace!
booking-5.negative: Mattress and pillows a little uncomfortable and no dishwasher...things we could live with! 😀

booking-6.title: A small but cosy holiday villa for a beach holiday
booking-6.text: What we liked most was the holiday atmosphere of the place and the villa. An unexpectedly quiet spot, even though there are lots of holidaymakers around. Corsican wine and snacks were a lovely little welcome gesture. Very helpful host. The kitchen is rather small, but well laid out; nothing was missing. There is a grill outside. A great beach is an 8-minute walk away. We would happily return.

booking-7.title: This is definitely 10 out of 10!
booking-7.text: Excellent apartment with everything you need - everything is very convenient, reliable and high quality. A very welcoming and responsive host who is always available and ready to help. An easy walk to a wonderful beach, a beautiful view, quiet at night. Wi-Fi would be a perfect addition to this apartment, but everything was great even without it! :-) Our holiday was a success, and we already want to come back!

abritel-1.text: Thank you to Michel for welcoming us into his beautiful apartment where we stayed for 1 week. He was very attentive to making sure our stay went as well as possible and gave us some good Corsican products on our arrival. The location is great with 2 beautiful beaches nearby (less than a 10-minute walk), and many others a few kilometres away by car. We were able to visit and enjoy the surroundings: sea, mountains, villages. Thanks again to the owner.

abritel-2.title: Perfect
abritel-2.text: Magnificent villa located not very far from the beach, really very convenient; the owners are friendly and accommodating, and they told me about some great spots. The interior is well maintained, the residential pool and bar area right next door has a superb view, just perfect!

abritel-3.text: Hello,We had a great time on Corsica. The apartment was nice with a beautiful surrounding, even with a view on the St Giulia bay. The beautiful beaches are nearby. Our host was very friendly and supporting. We would come back and stay in this place any time again.The only thing we would have to criticize would be that there could be a few more sharp knives and cutting boards for cutting vegetables and fruits, as we liked to prepare something in the evening. But that's just a small thing on the side, otherwise we felt very comfortable in the Mini Villa.

abritel-4.text: The villa is two stories, both with terraces - the top where the main bedroom is has an nice view including the sea. The photos don't do it justice, actually. While it is a short mostly flat walk to the beach, it is surprisingly quiet. The kitchen is equipped with everything you may need or want! This says a lot as we are couple that cooks while we are traveling and we were surprised. If you don't want to there are restaurants and a little shop all within walking distance. The host is available but also respects your privacy as well. He responded to our questions within minutes. In terms of location, you can't pick a better place to stay with so many great beaches close, including the one you can walk to! One of my favorite places on the island, only problem was I didn't book more days!

abritel-5.title: As shown in the photos. Very well located
abritel-5.text: A very good week, a 2-minute walk from the small supermarket to get warm bread in the morning and a 10-minute walk from the most beautiful beach in Corsica... If there were one small downside, it would be the noise from the neighbour at 7 in the morning. Otherwise a superb week

abritel-6.title: excellent
abritel-6.text: The setting is idyllic with a sea view, excellent amenities. THE SITE IS MAGNIFICENT in SANTA GIULIA near Bonifasio and porto vecchio, recommended.

abritel-7.title: Disappointed...
abritel-7.text: Two adults and a 1-year-old baby, we were attracted by the spaciousness of the accommodation (around 40m2)... To us the accommodation seemed closer to 30m2... Good for a couple on their own but with children it is very cramped. Unfortunately the terraces are unusable from 1pm to 5pm because they have no shade. A shame, as this shortcoming could easily be corrected and would allow lunch outside in the shade. As for the equipment, some basics are missing (no clothes pegs, no toaster, ...). Finally, to end on a detail that is admittedly trivial but unpleasant nonetheless, we found ants on the bedside table...

abritel-8.title: Great location
abritel-8.text: The apartment matches the description and photos. The location a 5-minute walk from Santa Giulia beach is really great. The view from the terraces is very nice. We did not try the restaurant’s pool; the sea a few minutes away is more pleasant.... A very pleasant stay out of season as there were not too many people and the weather was very nice. In summer when all the accommodation is occupied, it must be a little noisy.

abritel-9.title: A great stay
abritel-9.text: The setting is ideal! Close to the sea, you can go for a walk on the beach a 5-minute walk away at any time, and the water is always warm. The beaches attract a nice crowd and do not feel unsafe at all. You also have quick access to some very beautiful towns to visit, such as Bonifacio. I had a great stay and would happily go back.

abritel-10.title: exceptional location
abritel-10.text: the location of the accommodation is very pleasant, access to the beach is very easy and quick, the accommodation is very functional and well equipped, matching the listing; fortunately the owner gave us directions because it is easy to get lost and the signs are insufficient, especially at night. we regretted being unable to use the south- and west-facing uncovered terraces: the heat prevented us from having lunch and taking a nap there… a real shame considering that very little would be needed to provide shade….. we were greeted by the sound system at the pool of the hotel above, which made us fear the worst; luckily there were no parties during our stay because we had front-row seats for the decibels….still something to mention to summer holidaymakers coming to rest...

abritel-11.title: functional and ideally located
abritel-11.text: we had a very pleasant stay in this mini villa just a 5-minute walk from the superb santa giulia beach. It is clean, functional and ideally located for access to beaches, hikes and other activities. we will be back

abritel-12.title: Very high standard
abritel-12.text: Small villa in a quiet residential complex, offering all the comfort you could wish for, tasteful decor, immaculate condition. Being close to small shops is much appreciated. The highlight: access to Santa Julia bay in less than a 10-minute walk.

abritel-13.title: a little corner of paradise!!
abritel-13.text: Functional, very well-equipped and welcoming villa where you can rest in the evening after the day’s excursions. Well located for visiting Porto Vecchio, Bonifacio, the aiguilles de bavella.... Very close to the magnificent santa giulia beach (5-minute walk!!). We will go back!!

abritel-14.title: Everything for a good holiday.
abritel-14.text: Beautiful, well laid out and functional apartment for a very enjoyable holiday. We appreciated being close to the heavenly beach and especially not having to take the car. A little barbecue in the evening and sunbathing on the terrace. Lovely walks nearby when we wanted a change from the beach. In short, we recommend it both for families and for two.<

abritel-15.title: Very quiet little villa with every comfort
abritel-15.text: Very quiet little villa with every comfort, offering plenty of privacy from the neighbours. A very, very pleasant stay. A stone’s throw from the most beautiful part of the delightful Santa Giulia beach with translucent water. Convenient for children who can go swimming on their own. Rental well located for excursions in the surrounding area: Bonifacio and the aiguilles de Bavella with natural pools for swimming

abritel-16.title: VERY PLEASANT
abritel-16.text: RENTAL MATCHES THE DESCRIPTION IN THE LISTING. VERY PLEASANT VILLA NEAR THE BEACH. +++++

abritel-17.title: Excellent accommodation and both Mme Odette and Mme Januario are extremely kind!!! Highly recommended
abritel-17.text: The house is really lovely, the place enchanting! We have three children and had a wonderful time. We will return!

airbnb-1.text:
We had a very good stay. The surroundings are welcoming and peaceful.
In the middle of a heatwave, we were able to enjoy the air conditioning. Michel recommended magnificent beaches to us, one of them 2 km from the accommodation.
I recommend this accommodation for its tranquillity, which in particular allows you to get away from the crowds during the summer.

airbnb-2.text:
Perfect stay! Very beautiful house in a convenient location for going to the beach. 😌
Michel was very kind with everything!

airbnb-3.text: Our stay at Michel’s place was perfect! A delightful little break after our hike on the GR20. Michel is hospitable and attentive. The accommodation is very pleasant, with air conditioning that is much appreciated in the intense heat and everything you need! We really recommend this accommodation. Everything is within walking distance, a lovely beach, small shops and excellent restaurants!! Michel is very attentive and even drove us to the airport for a very reasonable price!! Thanks again, Michel, for your welcome 👍

airbnb-4.text:
Very good location for exploring the area around Porto Vecchio. The apartment is well situated, you can get to Santa Giulia beach in barely 10 minutes on foot! Well equipped and to the
 Simple and modern decor, we enjoyed both terraces! All in all, a very good stay!

airbnb-5.text:
Practical and functional apartment.
Much-appreciated air conditioning.
Close to the beach .
Very quiet residential complex.
Ideally situated for exploring all of southern Corsica
We enjoyed an excellent stay.

airbnb-6.text: Excellent stay in this accommodation for two couples. Although the size of the accommodation is quite limited, it has everything you need for your stay, as well as a few extras, such as a washing machine, for example. The downstairs terrace allows you to have a little barbecue or breakfast in the shade, while the one off the bedroom is perfect for having a drink with views of the sunrise over Santa Giulia bay. This magnificent beach is indeed just a 5-minute walk (about 300 metres) from the accommodation. You will also find a small local shop (200 m away), a bar-restaurant (50 m away, among the villas) and beachfront restaurants. Porto Vecchio and its shops are a 10-15 minute drive away, depending on traffic, and Bonifacio is between 30 and 45 minutes away. In short, our week there was almost too short to enjoy all the island’s charms. We would be very happy to return.

airbnb-7.text:
Clean accommodation, but lacking charm and with modest equipment. Don’t forget the sheets, towels and tea towels! 
What is appealing about this accommodation is the opportunity to live outdoors.
The lovely south-facing terrace with sea views and a barbecue is very pleasant. A magnificent beach is easily reached (a 10-minute walk away).

airbnb-8.text:
A very well-located villa in the Bella Vista development: very close to the beach and the small shops and restaurants at the marina. The views of Santa Giulia are beautiful and make you feel you have escaped it all. 
From there, you can explore Bonifacio, Porto Vecchio and all the beaches and streams, they are spectacular!
The villa is clean and well organised, and is functional and simple. The blankets were very welcome at the end of September. We would happily return!

airbnb-9.text:
A very good stay at Michel’s place. The accommodation is very pleasant, comfortable and well equipped, true to the description. 
It is in a quiet area with beautiful views of Santa Giulia bay.
A space is available to park the car right outside the accommodation. The beach is a 10-minute walk away.  
Michel was not there, but the person who welcomed us was very kind and available.
Thank you!

airbnb-10.text: The studio was clean, well equipped and in a quiet location on a hillside, within easy walking distance of the beaches of Santa Giulia. Great with children! Thank you!
